core_idea: Zwei Assoc. South Section 4 Gregor is a Tank / Status Specialist — **Aggro** frontliner — raise Aggro on key skill slots to pull enemy focus while the kit tanks or sets up.
playstyle_guide:
- Front-load **+5 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with Guard or Assist Defense so passives trigger under pressure.
- Skills grant **Haste** — chain them when you need higher Speed next turn.
- Hold S3 for when At 10+ Defense Level Up is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Standoff** (BP 4, CP +3, x2): rolls — low 4, high 10 (Extremely Low).
- Gain 2 Defense Level Up; [Clash Lose] Gain Shield by (5  Defense Level Up on self); Gain 2 Defense Level Up next turn

**S2 — Flexible Suppression** (BP 3, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 3, high 15 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits
- At 6+ Defense Level Up, deal +30% damage

**S3 — Guardian** (BP 5, CP +3, x3): rolls — low 5, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Apply 2 Defense Power Up and 3 Defense Level Up to all allies | Coin Power +1 per 6 Defense Level Up (Max 3).

Combat passive — **Combat Shield**: If targeted by 2 or more attacks at the start of the combat phase, gain 2 Defense Level Up.
  - If at 50% or less HP at the start of the combat phase, gain 3 Defense Level Up.

Combat passive — **Your Shield**: If 1 ally with the highest Max HP is targeted by 2 or more attacks, gain 3 Defense Level Up.

Defense skill — **Counter: The Best Defense**: [Combat Start] Gain Shield by (2  Defense Level Up on self).
  - [On Use] Gain +5 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn.
team_suggestions: **Aggro** frontliner — draws enemy focus so teammates can apply statuses and burst safely.
- Pair with identities whose support passives inflict statuses this kit stacks or scales off.
